items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: He's the one that taught me how to transpose; that's the first thing he taught me.

ctx.x: I said, "Oh, yeah? Thank you." He says, "I'm Frank O'Bannon." I says, "I know. I love you. I'm listening to you." He says, "Where did you hear me play?" So I says, "Well, you played the Ginn Theater." He says, "Sure." But he knew I hadn't been in the Ginn Theater. I said, "Well, look, I heard you in the alley." I says, "I was standing back there," and I says, "your sound is very beautiful." I says, "There's a lot of things I need to learn." He says, "I'll tell you what." He says, "I can't play jazz," he said,…
